title: Low-Level Design (Firmware Workflow)

node_notes.dispatch: dispatch_command handles STATUS, direction, frequency, duty, start, and stop commands and writes acknowledgements or errors. firmware/app/app.c also performs the start fault check before enabling the motor.
node_notes.shutdown: Shutdown forces all three duties to zero, stops TIM1 PWM, and places the driver in standby. These operations are implemented by motor_board_shutdown in firmware/platforms/stm32/stm32_motor_board.c.
node_notes.led_toggle: The status LED is toggled once per main-loop iteration independently of the 1 ms motor-control gate. Core/Src/main.c calls HAL_GPIO_TogglePin on the configured PA5 LED.
node_notes.delay: The main loop waits with HAL_Delay using APP_LED_PERIOD_MS, configured as 200 ms. After the delay, execution returns to UART polling and the next application iteration.
node_notes.boot: This step represents the actual reset-to-application path rather than Cube clock boilerplate. Core/Src/main.c performs HAL initialization and UART setup before entering app_start and the bare-metal loop.
node_notes.lifecycle_step: This step ramps frequency, advances the electrical angle, generates three phase duties, and changes the lifecycle to running when processing succeeds. motor_lifecycle_process in firmware/services/motor_lifecycle/motor_lifecycle.c returns false when the lifecycle is not starting or running.
node_notes.parse: A completed CR/LF line is accepted only when command_transport_line_push reports completion and command_parser_parse succeeds. The branch is implemented in process_uart in firmware/app/app.c and uses the command parser in firmware/modules/command_parser/command_parser.c.
node_notes.faultcheck: The application reads the motor driver fault input before producing a new waveform. firmware/app/app.c treats either a failed motor_board_read_fault call or an active fault as a fault path.
node_notes.init: app_start prepares the motor board, initializes UART command transport and motor lifecycle state, then shuts the motor down initially. The evidence is firmware/app/app.c, including motor_board_prepare, command_transport_line_initialize, motor_lifecycle_initialize, and motor_board_shutdown.
node_notes.tick: The motor control update is gated by APP_MOTOR_CONTROL_PERIOD_MS, which is 1 ms. app_process computes elapsed time from osal_uptime_ms and enters the control path only when the interval has elapsed.
node_notes.pwm: The generated duty_u, duty_v, and duty_w values are passed to the motor board adapter. firmware/platforms/stm32/stm32_motor_board.c forwards them to x_nucleo_ihm16m1_drive_motor, which updates TIM1 channel compares through the PWM callback.
node_notes.poll: process_uart drains bytes supplied by the USART2 interrupt-backed receive queue and pushes them into the command-line buffer. firmware/app/app.c calls uart_if_read_byte and command_transport_line_push for each available byte.
